Mira (arch): Quick follow-up from the version-smoother RFC — we sketched a sidecar that rewrites incoming requests to the new v4 shape for legacy clients and marks traces. want to align on rollout safety and observability before we start a spike.
Jon (infra): +1. main concerns: correctness of rewrite rules, perf overhead, and how we handle unknown/ambiguous payloads.
Sam (platform): For rollout, I suggest feature-flagged opt-in per-tenant for 2 weeks, then auto-opt for low-risk tenants. Keep the rewrite idempotent.
Lucy (ml): One more: model inputs change subtlely (tokenization flags). If we rewrite, we must preserve exact token stream or we risk subtle regressions. need eval harness to compare outputs.
Priya (sre): Observability asks: metric for rewritten rate, error rate post-rewrite, tail latency (p95/p99). Also a degrade path to bypass sidecar if latency spikes.
Mira (arch): Agreed. Proposal: sidecar exposes /rewrite-check that returns a deterministic diff summary instead of rewritten payload, and we run a small canary set to verify model parity.
Jon (infra): Perf note: keep rewrite in hot path but cheap — header sniff + small JSON affine transforms. Avoid full parse/serialize if possible. Example heuristic: look for header `X-Client-Version`. fallback: sniff body prefix.
Sam (platform): On telemetry: add a rewrite_reason tag (enum: header,vague-shape,explicit-optin) and original_client_version tag. We can use sampling for full payload captures.
Lucy (ml): I'll build an eval that runs incoming legacy requests through both legacy and rewritten paths and compares logits/embeddings. We'll surface a regression score. need ~100k samples to be confident.
Priya (sre): Canary plan: 1% traffic for internal tenants, monitor error & regression score for 24h, increase to 10% if green. Have an automated kill-switch that flips bypass when p99 latency > threshold or error_rate > 0.1%.
Jon (infra): Implementation sketch (pseudo):
```
if hdr = req.headers['X-Client-Version'] and parseFloat(hdr) < 4.0:
  rewritten = applyTransforms(req.body)
  annotateTrace('smoother.rewrite', hdr)
  forward(rewritten)
else:
  forward(req.body)
```
Sam (platform): Need a tenant opt-out header too, to allow customers to opt out of automatic rewrites during migration. e.g., `X-Rewrite-OptOut: true`.
Mira (arch): Backoff rules: if rewrite yields >1% semantic divergence in regression harness we should automatically flag and halt rollout. Also maintain a hashed copy of original payload in object store for repros (sampled).
Priya (sre): Storage note: only keep sampled originals for 7 days, redact PII by default. Ensure KMS encryption.
Lucy (ml): For unknown shapes, sidecar should fall through (no rewrite) and tag trace as `smoother.unknown_shape` so we can collect examples to expand transforms.
Sam (platform): Who owns the sidecar repo? ops + platform to co-own. infra to own deployment. Need clear SLAs for hotfixes.
Jon (infra): I'll open a repo and a minimal PoC image. Also propose a lightweight e2e test that replays recorded legacy requests.
Mira (arch): Next steps: Lucy build eval harness + sample set, Jon PoC sidecar, Sam rollout gating/flags, Priya define SLO kill thresholds. reconvene EOD Friday for initial results.
deploy-bot: deployed rollout-flag "version-smoother.optin" to staging :rocket: (2024-07-14 18:22)
Jon (infra): quick Q — do we want to attempt in-place streaming rewrites or only non-streaming requests for phase 1?
Mira (arch): phase 1: non-streaming only. streaming adds complexity to token-level fidelity. mark for phase 2.
Priya (sre): noted. I'll draft runbook snippets for bypass and rollback.
Sam (platform): I'll add the opt-out header and flag hooks to the feature-flag service.
Mira (arch): thanks everyone — feel free to drop short updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
